args.description: 读取 human-review-routing skill 的定义文件
执行 human-review-routing skill 的测试命令
args.command:
mkdir -p /mnt/user-data/outputs/human-review-routing /mnt/user-data/workspace/human-review-routing
python - <<'PY'
import json, pathlib
event = {"event_id":"EVT_REVIEW_001","event_type":"fight","confidence":0.62,"severity":"high","enforcement_impact":True}
health = {"health_status":"degraded","health_score":0.55,"issues":["blurred"]}
pathlib.Path('/mnt/user-data/workspace/human-review-routing').mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
json.dump(event, open('/mnt/user-data/workspace/human-review-routing/event.json','w'), ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
json.dump(health, open('/mnt/user-data/workspace/human-review-routing/health.json','w'), ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
PY
python /mnt/skills/custom/human-review-routing/scripts/run.py --event-json /mnt/user-data/workspace/human-review-routing/event.json --camera-health-json /mnt/user-data/workspace/human-review-routing/health.json --config /mnt/skills/custom/configs/deerflow_config.json --output /mnt/user-data/outputs/human-review-routing/result.json
